body:
Actual consumer failure with lino-objects-codec0.9.0 and Node22.23.0, while verifying a full saved Lazada associative case. The codec successfully emitted valid readable Links Notation, but cannot read it back.

The discovery-publication-source document contains1,764 historical proof records,144,497,741 UTF8 bytes, content SHA25633288f6b43e93e619e92eb622383da322ba8bb6022503dc6e8faa6f9c5a088a4 (gzip24,975,140 bytes). A smaller56,510,065-byte cache notation is also present. Source JSON, compressed/uncompressed hashes and binary frames remain intact.

Actual stack:
```
RangeError: Invalid array length
 at Function.from (<anonymous>)
 at tokenize (.../lino-objects-codec/src/readable.js:582:23)
 at Module.decode (.../src/readable.js:224:18)
 at ObjectCodec.decode (.../src/codec.js:200:21)
 at decode (.../src/codec.js:784:24)
```

`tokenize` calls `Array.from(text)` before scanning, multiplying memory use and reaching V8 backing-array limits for a valid large document. A narrow consumer workaround uses direct string indexing and string slices instead of the character array and corresponding slice/join calls. ASCII delimiters and complete Unicode text/quote runs must round-trip. The separate escaped-payload decoder also materializes arrays and deserves bounded Unicode/UTF8 processing for giant single values.

Please support decoding valid large documents without whole-document character arrays, preserve exact encoded/decoded JSON and Unicode/quote/escaped-marker behavior, and add a realistic regression. The consumer will keep verifying every saved notation record against JSON and binary conversion, not skip decode or remove history. A public fixed/failed archive receipt and consumer workaround link will follow after full validation and commit. No marketplace requests are needed to reproduce.

comments.body:
The consumer workaround is implemented in [lazada-search commit c7149901c187](https://github.com/konard/lazada-search/commit/c7149901c1877c12cc6a08c4e65ed0a42dd58224): [exact-source-gated installer](https://github.com/konard/lazada-search/blob/c7149901c1877c12cc6a08c4e65ed0a42dd58224/scripts/patch-lino-large-documents.mjs), [focused regression tests](https://github.com/konard/lazada-search/blob/c7149901c1877c12cc6a08c4e65ed0a42dd58224/tests/lino-large-documents.test.js).

Direct string-index scanning removes the whole-document character array; native slice/indexOf handling avoids retaining quoted-character ropes; bounded UTF-8 decoding preserves Unicode, escaping and malformed-input checks. The installer requires the exact official 0.9.0 source digest, retains the original locally, rejects unknown 0.9.0 source and leaves future official versions untouched. It does not use a global monkey patch.

Eight focused tests include a long quoted Unicode value in a 128 MiB child and a notation document over 32 MiB. Complete JSON/notation/binary/blob verification passes the actual previously failing 144,497,741-byte document and the final 34,253-record/7,030-blob case at the default Node heap, without dropping source history or skipping decoding. [Failure/success receipt](https://github.com/konard/lazada-search/blob/c7149901c1877c12cc6a08c4e65ed0a42dd58224/docs/acceptance/source-integrity/codec-large-document.json), [final verification](https://github.com/konard/lazada-search/blob/c7149901c1877c12cc6a08c4e65ed0a42dd58224/docs/acceptance/source-integrity/archive-verification.json). No product requests were made for diagnosis/rebuilding. The upstream issue remains open for an official library fix.

title: Readable decoder fails on valid 144MB document: tokenize materializes Array.from(text)
